mode: compile_only — no activation authorized; no live-session runtime, no live-mode default-voice response, no auto-execute path, and no new consent mode ships with this artifact

activation_gate.gate: This artifact defines the target shape ONLY. LiveVoiceSession is voice taxonomy category 2 (per docs/VOICE_MESSAGE_CONTRACT.md) and is explicitly NOT this-packet in the shipped UserVoiceNote rail (P4S-31D1-B). It belongs to a future implementation packet that is hard-held. Nothing in this artifact starts, schedules, enables a flag for, or permits a live voice session.
activation_gate.who_gates: the owner explicitly calls the LiveVoiceSession implementation packet in sequence, after the push-to-talk rail (P4S-31D-1) and its browser proof (P4S-31D-2) are proved; this artifact cannot self-authorize.
activation_gate.sequencing_dependency: LiveVoiceSession builds on the proven push-to-talk transcript-into-chat rail. It is NOT scheduled before that rail's server-truth proof exists.

taxonomy_binding.canonical_definition: Real-time conversation with DEX/Jarvis; voice is the DEFAULT response during live mode; transcript AND events are STILL recorded in the Cockpit Chat ledger; actions STILL require governance (hold-at-AWAITING_APPROVAL, proof). Grounded in docs/VOICE_MESSAGE_CONTRACT.md and data/umh/voice/voice_message_contract.json (voice_taxonomy.categories.LiveVoiceSession).
is: live real-time back-and-forth spoken conversation with DEX
voice-default response WHILE live mode is engaged
fully ledger-recorded — every operator turn and every DEX turn hits the Cockpit Chat ledger via the existing _save_turn path
fully governed — any ACTION a live turn implies routes to the held intent-loop gate exactly like a typed message
is_not: NOT dictation (that is UserVoiceNote / P4S-31D1-B — record → review → send a draft)
NOT ambient / wake-word activation (that is AmbientActivation / P4S-AMBIENT-ACTIVATION-001, held)
NOT outbound AI voice rendered in the operator's authorized voice (that is AIOutboundVoiceMessage / P4S-AI-OUTBOUND-VOICE-MESSAGE-001, compile-only, not built)
NOT a second way to reach the runtime — it remains an adapter into Cockpit Chat and the governed intent loop

binds_to_contracts: docs/VOICE_INTENT_CONTRACT.md (voice is a first-class adapter into Cockpit Chat; non-bypass invariants)

reuses.capture_transport: voice-ws.ts PCM16 @16kHz -> umh/voice_server.py (unchanged WS protocol on ws://:8096/voice)
reuses.stt_path: server STT via umh/voice_server.py — Groq whisper-large-v3-turbo, faster-whisper fallback (transcript-only transit; audio never persisted by the server)
reuses.tts_path: server TTS via umh/voice_server.py tts_request — Kokoro on the instance GPU node, espeak fallback (existing 'tts_request'/'tts_status'/'tts_error' messages)
reuses.chat_entry: chatStore.sendMessage(text, 'voice', routing, voice_turn_id) -> POST /advisor/converse (SAME endpoint text uses)
reuses.ledger_write: substrate/organism/advisor_conversation.py::DEXConversation.converse() persists BOTH the operator turn and the assistant turn via _save_turn() — the live session writes through this same path, no separate ledger
reuses.held_gate: transports/api/cockpit_chat_routes.py::try_chat_intent_rail -> governed_intent_submit -> IntentLoop.submit (held at AWAITING_APPROVAL; advances only via IntentLoop.decide)
reuses.barge_in: cockpit/src/renderer/api/voice-controller.ts vad_status handler — when VAD active AND ttsState=='speaking', client.cancelTts() + cancelPlayback() + micState='interrupted'. LiveVoiceSession REUSES this exact barge-in; it does not invent a new one.
reuses.turn_correlation: voice-turn-assembler.ts voice_turn_id (vt-<uuid>) threads capture -> transcript -> chat -> loop
reuses.presentation_envelope: voiceStore.ts OrganismResponseEnvelope + heldEnvelope hold text+audio until ready-to-commit together (existing held-message presentation)

session_lifecycle.description: Explicit lifecycle for one live voice session on one surface. Extends VoiceSession (voice_intent_contract_types.json) — it does NOT redefine VoiceSession fields.

transitions.on: operator engages live mode with an ACTIVE consent grant for the live mode + OS mic permission + feature flag ON
voice_server WS connected; mic open; session bound to the operator Clerk principal (resolved server-side) and the DeviceSession
speech detected above VAD threshold (reuses voice-controller audio_level threshold)
utterance boundary reached — server STT produces the TranscriptEvent (final=true)
final transcript enters chat verbatim via sendMessage(source='voice') -> /advisor/converse; DEX composes a response; voice is the DEFAULT response modality in live mode
converse() persists BOTH the operator transcript turn and the assistant response turn to the Cockpit Chat ledger via _save_turn — this is not optional and is not a separate store
response committed (text+audio via the held presentation envelope); session re-opens the mic for the next turn — a live session is a loop of turns
barge-in: operator speaks while DEX is talking -> cancelTts() -> interrupted -> mic re-opens (reuses existing voice-controller barge-in)
operator ends live mode, consent revoked, feature flag OFF, WS lost, or inactivity timeout
mic released, WS closed, TTS cancelled; no residual capture

session_lifecycle.turn_is_the_unit: A live session is a sequence of turns. Each turn is: listen -> capture -> transcribe -> (chat ledger) -> respond -> (chat ledger). Ending a turn does NOT end the session; ending the session releases the mic.
session_lifecycle.reuse_note: This is a session-loop composed of the already-proven single-turn seam; it does not introduce a parallel capture or transcript pipeline.

turn_taking_and_barge_in.model: half-duplex with barge-in override. DEX speaks (TTS) OR the operator speaks; the operator may interrupt DEX at any time.
turn_taking_and_barge_in.barge_in_reuse: REUSES the existing barge-in in cockpit/src/renderer/api/voice-controller.ts: on vad_status active while ttsState=='speaking', the client calls cancelTts(), cancelPlayback(), sets ttsState idle and micState 'interrupted'. LiveVoiceSession does NOT define a new barge-in mechanism.
turn_taking_and_barge_in.operator_always_wins: The operator can always interrupt DEX mid-utterance; DEX never talks over a speaking operator.
turn_taking_and_barge_in.turn_end_detection: utterance boundary from the existing VAD/silence detection in voice-controller.ts + voice_server.py (SILENCE_END_UTTERANCE_S). A silence ends the OPERATOR turn; it never triggers an action and never sends anything ungoverned.

voice_default_response_rule.rule: WHILE live mode is engaged, DEX's default response modality is voice (TTS via the existing tts_request seam) in addition to the text that always lands in the ledger. Voice-default applies ONLY inside an active live session; outside live mode the default is text.
voice_default_response_rule.text_is_never_skipped: Voice is the default PRESENTATION, not a replacement for the text turn. Every DEX response still produces a text turn written to the Cockpit Chat ledger. Voice is rendered FROM that text via TTS; the ledger record is the text.
voice_default_response_rule.commit_together: Text and audio commit together via the existing held presentation envelope (voiceStore OrganismResponseEnvelope / heldEnvelope) so the operator never sees text without its spoken form lagging incoherently.
voice_default_response_rule.degradation: If TTS fails (tts_error), the text turn still commits to the ledger and is shown — voice-default degrades to text, never to silence-plus-lost-turn (Deterministic-First Principle).

ledger_recording.rule: Transcript AND events are STILL recorded in the Cockpit Chat ledger. A live session has NO private, unlogged channel.
ledger_recording.operator_turn: each finalized operator transcript is written to the ledger as a chat message with source='voice' and the voice_turn_id, via converse()/_save_turn — identical to a typed message's persistence.
ledger_recording.assistant_turn: each DEX response is written to the ledger as an assistant turn via _save_turn — identical to a typed conversation's persistence.
ledger_recording.events: session lifecycle events (session opened, turn started, barge-in, held-at-approval, proof recorded, session closed) are recorded as chat/loop events in the same thread the operator sees; a live turn that implies an action produces the SAME AWAITING_APPROVAL event a typed action produces.
ledger_recording.verbatim: the ledger's operator message content equals the final TranscriptEvent.text, unmodified — voice does not pre-interpret (VoiceIntentContract invariant 6).
ledger_recording.no_separate_store: the live session writes through DEXConversation.converse()/_save_turn — there is no second ledger, no bypass, no in-memory-only transcript.

governance_boundary.principle: Conversational turns are chat. Any ACTION a live turn implies routes to the held intent-loop gate. A live session NEVER auto-executes.

two_paths_same_endpoint.conversational_turn: reaches DEX via /advisor/converse and is answered conversationally + written to the ledger. No action, no mutation.
two_paths_same_endpoint.action_implying_turn: the SAME /advisor/converse call runs try_chat_intent_rail -> deterministic classify_intent(text) -> if INTENT_CAPTURE, governed_intent_submit -> IntentLoop.submit -> HELD at AWAITING_APPROVAL. The live session surfaces the held item in-thread and waits for explicit operator approval; only IntentLoop.decide advances it to PROOF_RECORDED.

governance_boundary.no_live_mode_auto_advance: Being in live/voice mode grants NO extra authority. A spoken action is classified identically to a typed one (classify_intent ignores source) and holds at AWAITING_APPROVAL exactly the same. There is no 'voice confirms by voice-and-executes' path in this artifact.
governance_boundary.approval_is_explicit: approval of a held live-turn action still requires an explicit governed approve (intent_loop_approval_decision); decided_by is the authenticated Clerk principal resolved server-side, never spoofed by a voice payload.
governance_boundary.same_proof_chain: a live-origin INTENT_CAPTURE produces a ProofRecord under the registered intent_loop_approval_decision MutationSpec — the P4S-31C proof chain, one hop further back (spoken word instead of typed).
non_bypass_invariants_inherited: same endpoint: a live utterance reaches the runtime ONLY through POST /advisor/converse with source='voice' — no voice-specific submit route
same classifier: classify_intent receives text only; source is never passed to it
same gate: a live-origin INTENT_CAPTURE holds at AWAITING_APPROVAL with proof is None; no auto-advance
same identity: decided_by is the authenticated Clerk operator principal, server-resolved
transcript-only transit: /advisor/converse carries text, never audio bytes

consent_model.principle: Consent is PER-MODE (VoiceIntentContract). A push_to_talk grant does NOT authorize a live session, and a live-session grant does NOT authorize wake_word or always_on.
consent_model.future_grantable_note: The 'live_session' consent mode is DECLARED here as future-grantable, NOT grantable now. No grant of this mode may be created, no UI to grant it may ship, and no code path may treat a push_to_talk grant as sufficient for a live session, until the LiveVoiceSession implementation packet is owner-authorized.
consent_model.fail_closed: Absent an ACTIVE VoiceConsentGrant(live_session), live mode refuses to open — fail-closed, a typed VoiceOutcome (CONSENT_REQUIRED), never a degraded ungoverned path.

revocation.rule: revoking the live_session grant (revoked_at set) stops capture and closes the session immediately; the mic is released at once.

consent_model.two_layers: OS/browser microphone permission AND the UMH VoiceConsentGrant(live_session) are BOTH required; either missing = refusal.
consent_model.orchestrator_exclusion: the orchestrator-role node (infra/device_registry.json) NEVER opens a live session — DeviceCapabilityProfile.has_microphone=false for that role, always. No mic on the orchestrator.

stt.engine: server STT via umh/voice_server.py — Groq whisper-large-v3-turbo (default, network-bound), faster-whisper fallback (local CPU)
stt.transit: transcript-only — audio bytes never cross the chat seam; the server writes utterance PCM to a temp WAV only for the STT call and unlinks it immediately (success or failure)
stt.logging_law: transcript text is never logged at INFO or above; bounded <=40-char DEBUG previews only

tts.engine: server TTS via umh/voice_server.py tts_request — Kokoro on the instance GPU node, espeak fallback
tts.trigger: DEX response text -> tts_request -> Kokoro synthesis -> audio streamed to the browser -> tts_status(speaking)
tts.no_outbound_voice: TTS here renders DEX's response for the operator IN the live session ONLY. It NEVER renders the operator's authorized voice, never sends voice to a third party, and never clones any voice — that is AIOutboundVoiceMessage (P4S-AI-OUTBOUND-VOICE-MESSAGE-001), NOT this artifact.

stt_tts_path.protocol_unchanged: the voice_server WS protocol (mic_start/mic_stop/tts_request/tts_cancel + binary PCM16 in, transcript/tts_status/audio out) is UNCHANGED — LiveVoiceSession composes existing messages, it does not add a new wire protocol.

state_store_shape.description: State the live session needs, expressed against the EXISTING voiceStore — it does NOT fork a parallel store.
reuses_from_voiceStore: consentState (unknown|required|granting|active) — extended in the future packet to cover the live_session mode; NOT changed here

future_fields_declared_not_added.note: These are the SHAPE a future implementation would add. This artifact does NOT add them to voiceStore.ts (compile-only).
future_fields_declared_not_added.liveSessionId: string | null — DeviceSession-correlated live session id, server-bound to the Clerk principal
future_fields_declared_not_added.liveModeEngaged: bool — true only while a live session is open; drives the voice-default-response rule
future_fields_declared_not_added.turnIndex: int — monotonic turn counter within the session (for event ordering in the ledger)

state_store_shape.identity_never_client_stamped: the session's operator principal is resolved server-side (Clerk); the store never stamps identity.

cpu_gate_budget.law: CPU Gate Law (CLAUDE.md) — a live session must NEVER saturate CPU on any host.
cpu_gate_budget.server_stt_tts: the STT/TTS server is bound by the existing umh-voice-server.service unit (CPUQuota=150% / MemoryMax=1G, measured worst case with faster-whisper fallback). LiveVoiceSession adds NO new server process and MUST NOT raise these bounds without re-measuring.

cpu_bounds.session_client_overhead_note: the live-session loop is orchestration over the existing per-turn seam; it adds bounded client-side event handling, not a new compute worker

cpu_gate_budget.self_disarm: on sustained budget breach the session degrades: TTS is dropped first (text-only turns still commit to the ledger), then the session closes fail-closed rather than saturating the host.
cpu_gate_budget.no_always_on: a live session is operator-engaged and bounded by an inactivity timeout — it is NOT an always-on mic and does NOT keep the STT engine hot when closed.

rollback_plan.flag_off: the live-mode feature flag defaults OFF; with it OFF, no live session can open — there is no live mode. This is the primary rollback.
rollback_plan.revoke: revoking VoiceConsentGrant(live_session) stops capture and closes any open session immediately.
rollback_plan.no_activation_no_rollback_needed: because this artifact activates nothing, rollback of the artifact itself is a no-op: deleting the compile artifacts removes documentation only, no runtime behavior changes.
rollback_plan.artifact_rollback: revert the commit that added data/umh/voice/live_voice_session_compile.json, docs/LIVE_VOICE_SESSION_COMPILE.md, and tests/test_p4s_live_voice_compile_artifacts.py — nothing else is touched.

forbidden_in_this_packet: implementation code for any live-session runtime (no session loop, no live-mode wiring)
activation of live mode or any live feature flag
auto-execute of any action implied by a voice turn — actions ALWAYS hold at AWAITING_APPROVAL
creating or granting a VoiceConsentGrant(live_session) — the mode is future-grantable, not grantable now
provider execution or live projection DB writes
outbound AI voice, voice cloning, or rendering the operator's voice
a separate voice execution path that bypasses Cockpit Chat / the intent loop
ambient / wake-word / always-on activation (that is P4S-AMBIENT-ACTIVATION-001, held)
adding any new server process or raising the umh-voice-server CPU/memory bounds
device_binding_note: devices are referenced by infra/device_registry.json role/id only — never hostnames or device-name literals; the operator identity is the Clerk principal resolved server-side.
